card.name: Body-position words in device instructions
card.fires_on: The word 'the' or 'your' after a position word like behind, under or over, and push/pull verbs, in step-by-step instructions for devices. It also fires on scattered name and phone-number pieces.

modes.label: Position phrases in steps
modes.description: 'the' or 'your' right after behind, under or similar in handling or fitting directions.
modes.example: Hands must remain behind<< the>> needle at all times during use and disposal

modes.label: Push or pull verbs
modes.description: Action verbs like Push or pulling that start or continue a device step.
modes.example: Put two fingers on “shoulders” of pump unit, and place thumb on bottom of bottle.<< Push>> bottle with thumb FIRMLY and QUICK

modes.label: Names and numbers
modes.description: Partway through a surname or a phone number.
modes.example: Gary A.<< Gr>>appo was sworn in as US Ambassador
